Roth }} '''Infernal Blow''' is a [[melee]] [[attack]] skill that converts 60% of Physical Damage to [[Fire]] Damage and applies a debuff to enemies. The debuff causes enemies to [[explode]] on death, dealing [[secondary damage]]. Additionally, if the debuff has charges, it deals [[attack]] [[area]] damage when an enemy gains 6 stacks, when the debuff expires, or when the enemy dies. This skill requires a sword, axe, mace, staff or unarmed. ==Skill functions and interactions== [[Damage conversion]]: Like all converted damage, the fire portion of Infernal Blow's damage will be modified by both fire damage increases and physical damage increases. '''Uncharged debuff''': At 0 charges, the debuff only causes enemies to [[explode]] on death, scaling with the affected enemy's maximum life. * The explosion deals [[fire]] [[area]] [[secondary damage]] and cannot be reflected. It does not use your weapon, nor does it scale with modifiers to attack or melee damage. It ''can'' be scaled by generic modifiers and {{c|mod|Elemental Damage with Attack Skills}}. Like other corpse explosions, it ignores life bonuses from [[partying]] and atlas keystones like [[Wellspring of Creation]].{{cite web|author=Mark_GGG|date=February 3, 2013 5:35 AM|title=Devs and other GD people - Kripps Death a good thing|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/93787/page/6#p1015274|publisher=Path of Exile Forum|accessdate=August 2, 2013}} The corpse explosion will generally prevent on-death effects, such as porcupine spines, as well as prevent enemy necromancers from resurrecting the corpses, like other explode-on-death effects. '''Charged debuff''': With 1 or more charge, the debuff will also deal attack area damage on expiration, enemy death, or reaching 6 charges. * Charges are only applied to enemies hit with the strike directly. Additional enemies hit by melee splash will only receive the uncharged debuff. * Explosions from enemy deaths, or from the charged debuff being stacked to full/expiring will not apply further debuffs to untouched enemies, preventing chaining explosions. * Only one charge can be applied per attack. This means [[repeat]]ing with e.g. {{il|Multistrike Support}} will only apply a charge every 3 hits. As the full-stack charged debuff explosion is a large part of this skill's damage (especially when gem quality is scaled), using multistrike or other attack repeats is generally DPS negative. * Each application of either debuff refreshes the debuff's [[duration]]. * The charged debuff deals the exact same damage types as the melee hit, plus {{c|mod|area damage}}.{{cite web|author=Mark_GGG|date=Jun 6, 2018, 6:22:38 PM|title=So I still don't understand the new mechanics of Infernal Blow at all... (Page 1)|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/2157665/page/1#p15588759|publisher=Path of Exile Forum|accessdate=November 13, 2018}} It is considered a new "bonus" hit and is not based on the hits that applied its charges,https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/tp6v0z/comment/i2c463f/ and does NOT detonate the uncharged debuff that deals a percentage of monster life. * For the purposes of [[Ruthless Support|Ruthless Blows]] and [[exert]]ing, the attack responsible for the debuff's hit depends on how that hit was caused. If the debuff reached 6 charges, then it is considered a hit from the attack that applied the 6th (and the explosion will be considered Ruthless/exerted if the 6th hit was). If the debuff expired for any other reason (such as the monster dying), it's considered a hit from the attack that applied the 1st stack instead.{{cite web|author=Mark_GGG|date=Jun 7, 2018, 5:47:47 PM|title=So I still don't understand the new mechanics of Infernal Blow at all... (Page 2)|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/2157665/page/2#p15592595|publisher=Path of Exile Forum|accessdate=November 13, 2018}} '''Multiple skill gems''': If an enemy with a charged debuff from one gem is hit by infernal blow from another gem, the previous debuff is removed without dealing damage. This means that you can't use one set of links to apply the first 5 debuffs and a different one to cause 6-charge debuff damage. Different sources (i.e. {{il|General's Cry}} mirages) can stack charged debuffs, as long as the skill is provided by the same gem. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression }} {{Item acquisition}} {{Skill enchantment modifier list}} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.25.0| * No longer has Added Fire Damage at all gem levels. * It now has 164% Effectiveness of Base and Added Damage at gem level 1 (previously 104%), scaling up to 377% at gem level 20 (previously 166%). * Now has a Mana cost of 6 at gem level 1, scaling up to 10 at gem level 20 (previously 6 at all gem levels). }} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Quality now causes the debuff to deal +0-10% of Damage per Charge, instead of providing 0-10% increased Area of Effect. }} {{Version history table row|3.16.0| * The following [[Strike|Skills]] no longer have “+0-2 to Melee Strike Range”: {{il|Dominating Blow}}, {{il|Double Strike}}, {{il|Vaal Double Strike}}, {{il|Dual Strike}}, {{il|Elemental Hit}}, {{il|Frenzy}}, [[Infernal Blow]], {{il|Pestilent Strike}}, {{il|Puncture}}, {{il|Riposte}}, {{il|Static Strike}}, {{il|Smite}}, {{il|Viper Strike}}, and {{il|Wild Strike}}. }} {{Version history table row|3.15.0| * Now deals 166% of Base Damage, and has 166% Effectiveness of Added Damage at gem level 20 (previously 133%). }} {{Version history table row|3.11.0| * Now converts 60% of Physical Damage to Fire Damage (from 50%). }} {{Version history table row|3.7.0| * Now deals base damage equal to, and has an added damage effectiveness of, 104% at gem level 1 (from 100%), up to 133% at gem level 20 (from 123%). * Now adds 5 to 8 fire damage to attacks at gem level 1, up to 75 to 113 at gem level 20. }} {{Version history table row|3.3.0| * Previously placed a debuff for 0.5 seconds on enemies hit by the skill.
